scripts.text:
[Prontera Guard]
Welcome to Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[普隆德拉卫兵]
欢迎来到普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Shuger]
Outside the safety of the city, there is a pink beast known as ^000077Poring^000000.
scripts.translation:
[舒格]
在城市安全区域之外，有一种被称为^000077波利^000000的粉色生物。

scripts.text:
[Shuger]
Though it's cute in appearance and does not actively harm people, Poring is known to absorb items that are on the ground into its own body.
scripts.translation:
[舒格]
虽然它们外表可爱且不会主动伤害人类，但众所周知，波利会把掉落在地上的物品吸进自己的身体里。

scripts.text:
[Shuger]
So if there's something on the ground that you want to pick up, be careful lest it be consumed by a Poring. Then again... Porings are pretty weak...
scripts.translation:
[舒格]
所以，如果你在地上看到想要捡起的物品，一定要小心别被波利吞掉了。不过话说回来……波利其实挺弱的……

scripts.text:
[Shuger]
The green colored ^000077Poporing^000000 is tougher than Poring. Newbies generally make the mistake of attacking it without being aware of its power... So be careful!
scripts.translation:
[舒格]
绿色的^000077Poporing^000000比波利更强壮。新手通常会因为没意识到它的力量而贸然攻击它……所以要小心！

scripts.text:
[Tono]
Did you know?
scripts.translation:
[托诺]
你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Tono]
The larva of Creamy is Fabre. So, those green little wormy things are actually the babies of those pinkish, purply butterfly things you see around.
scripts.translation:
[托诺]
克瑞米的幼虫是绿棉虫。所以，那些绿色的小虫子其实就是你周围看到的那些粉紫色蝴蝶生物的宝宝。

scripts.text:
[Tono]
But before Fabres can become Creamys, they go into a pupa stage. When that happens, they turn into these dark purple cocoons we call Pupa. Simple, huh?
scripts.translation:
[托诺]
但在绿棉虫变成克瑞米之前，它们会进入虫蛹阶段。发生这种情况时，它们会变成我们称之为虫蛹的深紫色茧。很简单吧？

scripts.text:
[Tono]
There's another monster that goes through a really big change... Pickys.
scripts.translation:
[托诺]
还有另一种会经历巨大变化的怪物……小鸡。

scripts.text:
[Tono]
Pickys are so cute when they're young, but when they grow up, they turn into those big, gawky looking Peco Pecos. Talk about awkward puberty.
scripts.translation:
[托诺]
小鸡小时候非常可爱，但长大后，它们会变成那种大块头、笨拙的大嘴鸟。这青春期过渡得可真够尴尬的。

scripts.text:
[Merideth]
The weather was nice on my day off so my family and I went for a picnic. We chose to go to a slightly secluded area where I saw something really interesting...
scripts.translation:
[梅雷迪斯]
我休息那天天气很好，所以我和家人去野餐了。我们选择去了一个稍微偏僻的地方，在那里我看到了非常有趣的事情……

scripts.text:
[Merideth]
It was a large group of Giant Hornets! What was even weirder was that they were all controlled by this one Queen Bee, following her every command.
scripts.translation:
[梅雷迪斯]
那是一大群狂暴蜂兵！更奇怪的是，它们全都受一只女王蜂控制，听从她的每一个指令。

scripts.text:
[Merideth]
They might just be bugs, but I think they've got the right idea. Men really ought to take commands from us women... We do things right!
scripts.translation:
[梅雷迪斯]
它们可能只是昆虫，但我认为它们的做法很正确。男人真应该听从我们女性的指挥……我们做事更有章法！

scripts.text:
[YuPi]
Although many monsters may look the same, be careful! There are variations among monsters that have the same basic form.
scripts.translation:
[尤皮]
虽然许多怪物看起来很相似，但要小心！具有相同基本形态的怪物之间也存在差异。

scripts.text:
[YuPi]
One monster, that looks just like a peaceful and weak one that you've already encountered, may actually be wild and ferocious!
scripts.translation:
[尤皮]
有些怪物看起来和你之前遇到的那种温顺弱小的怪物一模一样，但实际上可能非常狂野凶猛！

scripts.text:
[YuPi]
You can tell these kinds of monsters apart by their body color. Wilder and more powerful monsters have more dangerous looking colors.
scripts.translation:
[尤皮]
你可以通过它们的体色来区分这类怪物。越狂野、越强大的怪物，颜色看起来就越危险。

scripts.text:
[YuNa]
Behold...
Mighty Odin!
God of wisdom!
God of war!
scripts.translation:
[尤娜]
看啊……
伟大的奥丁！
智慧之神！
战争之神！

scripts.text:
[YuNa]
Here, in Rune-Midgarts, we serve Odin, the fearsome god who sacrificed one of his eyes in order to acquire wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[尤娜]
在卢恩·米德加兹，我们侍奉着奥丁，这位为了获得智慧而牺牲了一只眼睛的威严之神。

scripts.text:
[YuNa]
The statue you see behind of me is a sculpture of mighty Odin. But, it's a shame because it's such a bad likeness.
scripts.translation:
[尤娜]
我身后的那座雕像就是伟大的奥丁像。不过，真遗憾，它雕刻得一点都不像。

scripts.text:
[YuNa]
I mean, this statue is totally different from our image of Odin. I guess the sculptor took too many artistic liberties.
scripts.translation:
[尤娜]
我是说，这座雕像和我们心目中的奥丁形象完全不同。我想雕塑家在艺术创作上发挥得太过了吧。

scripts.text:
[YuNa]
I bet the first time you saw this statue, you thought, '^3355FFOh, what a nice muscle man on a horse^000000.'
scripts.translation:
[尤娜]
我敢打赌，你第一次看到这座雕像时，一定在想：'^3355FF喔，骑在马上的肌肉男子真帅啊^000000。'

scripts.text:
[YuNA]
But this statue is obviously not muscular enough, not godly enough to fairly represent a god! Maybe if he had a halo?
scripts.translation:
[尤娜]
但这座雕像显然肌肉不够发达，也不够神圣，无法公平地代表一位神！也许如果他有个光环就好了？

scripts.text:
[Strife]
Whew!
Man oh man...
I'm gonna be such
an awesome Knight!
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
呼！
天呐...
我一定会成为一名
超厉害的骑士！

scripts.text:
[Strife]
I know, I know...
First, I gotta be a Swordie. But if I keep practicing, I can become an awesome Swordie. And then after that...
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
我知道，我知道...
首先，我得先当个剑士。但只要我坚持练习，我就能成为一名超厉害的剑士。然后在那之后...

scripts.text:
[Strife]
I'll be the most
awesomest Knight around!
It's... It's my most precious dream.
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
我会成为这世上
最最厉害的骑士！
这...这是我最珍贵的梦想。

scripts.text:
[Strife]
MAGNUM BREAK!
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
连环重击！

scripts.text: I wanna be strong too!
scripts.translation: 我也想变得很强！

scripts.text: Um... Do you best.
scripts.translation: 嗯...加油吧。

scripts.text:
[Strife]
Wow...!
That's so awesome!
We both share the
same dream!
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
哇...！
那太帅了！
我们的梦想
是一样的！

scripts.text:
[Strife]
Hey, if you wanna become a Swordie, you gotta go to Izlude. There, you can go ahead and take the Swordman job test. The first time, I, um, failed miserably. But I won't fail again!
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
嘿，如果你想成为剑士，就得去依斯鲁得岛。在那里，你可以去参加剑士转职测试。第一次的时候，我，呃，惨败了。但我不会再失败了！

scripts.text:
[Strife]
Training! Training! Gotta keep training! You need to be strong too! Once we both get stronger, we'll meet again!
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
训练！训练！必须不断训练！你也需要变得更强！等我们都变强了，我们还会再见面的！

scripts.text:
[Strife]
Heh heh! I will for sure! 'Strife, the courageous Knight.' It sounds cool, doesn't it?
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
嘿嘿！我一定会实现的！“勇敢的骑士，斯特莱夫。”听起来很酷，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Strife]
Fight...!
Fight Fight FIGHT!
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
战斗...！
战斗 战斗 战斗！

scripts.text:
[Strife]
Hey...!
You look different now. *Gasp* You've gotten... ^993333stronger^000000. Wow, that's so coooool!
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
嘿...！
你现在看起来不一样了。*喘气* 你变得... ^993333更强了^000000。哇，太酷了！

scripts.text:
[Strife]
I'm so jealous!
I guess that means
that now, I gotta
train even harder!
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
我好嫉妒！
我想这意味着
我现在必须
更加努力地训练了！

scripts.text:
[Strife]
This is, well, for you to help you get even stronger. I guess I want to thank you for being such a good example.
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
这个，嗯，是给你用来变得更强的。我想谢谢你成为了一个这么好的榜样。

scripts.text:
[Strife]
Fight! Fight!
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
战斗！战斗！

scripts.text:
[Strife]
Whew!
Man oh man...
I'm gonna be such
an awesome Knight!
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
呼！
天呐...
我一定会成为一名
超厉害的骑士！

scripts.text:
[Strife]
I know, I know...
First, I gotta be a Swordie. But if I keep practicing, I can become an awesome Swordie. And then after that...
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
我知道，我知道...
首先，我得先当个剑士。但只要我坚持练习，我就能成为一名超厉害的剑士。然后在那之后...

scripts.text:
[Strife]
I'll be the most
awesomest Knight around!
It's... It's my most precious dream.
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
我会成为这世上
最最厉害的骑士！
这...这是我最珍贵的梦想。

scripts.text: Do your best.
scripts.translation: 加油。

scripts.text: Quit it, kid.
scripts.translation: 够了，孩子。

scripts.text:
[Strife]
Yes, yes of course! Someday, I'll even be as strong as you! When that day comes, I hope that we can train together!
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
是的，是的，当然了！总有一天，我也会变得和你一样强！等到那天到来时，我希望我们可以一起训练！

scripts.text:
[Strife]
Wha--?
Fine! But I'm gonna keep on training, and we'll see who gets the last laugh!
scripts.translation:
[斯特莱夫]
什么——？
好啊！但我会继续训练的，咱们走着瞧，看最后谁笑得出来！

scripts.text:
[Towngirl Dairenne]
Ahh...
The streets are too crowded these days. *Cough Cough* Look at all this dust, not everything about living in the capital city is good. Anyway, may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[镇民少女 黛莲]
啊……
最近街道上太拥挤了。*咳咳* 你看这些灰尘，住在首都并不全是好事。总之，有什么我可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Towngirl Dairenne]
I wonder if you are interested in parties or dresses. Hehehe. These days, the hot topic is definitely the colorful, extravagant, magnificent dresses you can wear.
scripts.translation:
[镇民少女 黛莲]
我在想你是否对派对或礼服感兴趣。呵呵呵。最近最热门的话题绝对是那些色彩斑斓、华丽又壮观的礼服。

scripts.text:
[Towngirl Dairenne]
To get such dazzling colors, I heard you have to use a dye that you can only get in Morocc. But I also heard that the price is beyond imagination.
scripts.translation:
[镇民少女 黛莲]
为了获得那种耀眼的光泽，我听说必须使用只能在莫洛克获得的染料。但我听说那价格也高得超乎想象。

scripts.text:
[Towngirl Dairenne]
Aahhhh~ I wish I could wear such a dress. Even if it's just once...
scripts.translation:
[镇民少女 黛莲]
啊啊啊~ 我真希望我也能穿上那样的礼服。哪怕只有一次也好……

scripts.text:
[Towngirl Dairenne]
Eh~? Why talk to me in the first place? What a strange person.
scripts.translation:
[镇民少女 黛莲]
诶~？你一开始为什么要找我说话？真是个奇怪的人。

scripts.text:
[Library Girl Ellen]
Here in the Eastern branch of the Prontera Library, we provide Monster Encyclopedias in which creatures are organized by their properties. We also have books on Merchant and Blacksmith skills.
Ooh~! The other branch of our library also has many interesting things to read! So if you get a chance, you just might want to visit.
scripts.translation:
[图书馆女孩 艾伦]
在普隆德拉图书馆的东分馆，我们提供按属性分类的怪物百科全书。我们这里也有关于商人与铁匠技能的书籍。
噢~！我们图书馆的其他分馆也有很多有趣的东西可以阅读！所以如果有机会，你也许会想去看看。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
The Prontera Culvert sewers have been left unattended for a long time. Now that place is infested with ^000077Thief Bugs^000000!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
普隆德拉下水道已经很久没人管了。现在那里到处都是^000077浮勒盗虫^000000！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
These Thief Bugs seem to quickly grab items dropped on the ground, and then run away with them... They're even more annoying than cockroaches!!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
这些浮勒盗虫似乎会很快捡起掉在地上的物品，然后带着它们逃跑……它们比蟑螂还要烦人！！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I dunno if you'll believe me, but I saw the weirdest thing down in the ^000077Culvert Sewers^000000...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我不知道你信不信，但我刚才在^000077下水道^000000里看到了最奇怪的事情……

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I've been training in the 3rd level for so long that there isn't anything that I don't know about in that area. But when I finally went to the 4th level...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我在三层训练了这么久，那里已经没有什么是我不知道的了。但当我终于去到四层的时候……

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
There, I saw a shimmering light. I was completely captivated and went to approach it. It must have been some sort of beautiful fairy...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
在那里，我看到了一道闪烁的光。我完全被吸引住了，于是走上前去靠近它。那一定是个美丽的精灵……

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
But when I got
close enough,
I saw it was
a ^000077Thief Bug^000000!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
但当我走近时，我发现那竟然是一只^000077浮勒盗虫^000000！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I've never seen a Thief Bug shining with light before! Man, just when you think you've seen it all...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我以前从未见过会发光的浮勒盗虫！天哪，就在你以为见多识广的时候……

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Sigh...as more and more people coming into Prontera,
better and better my business has become nowadays. But...
Well, I am having a hard time to keep a good stock of food ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
唉……随着来到普隆德拉的人越来越多，我的生意也越来越好了。但是……
唉，我现在很难维持充足的食材库存。

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
As you see, the numbers of the monsters outside of town has been greatly increased and they have caused trouble to my suppliers to deliver the goods at a right time.
I cannot make my ultra nice menus with common ingredients because they are super special!
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
如你所见，城外的怪物数量大幅增加，这导致我的供应商很难按时送货。
我不能用普通的食材来制作我那些超棒的菜单，因为那些食材非常特别！

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
So I have been contacting super heavy champion hunters for fresh and special ingredients.
But the demand has exceeded the supply in these days.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
所以我一直在联系那些超强力的猎人，去寻找新鲜且特殊的食材。
但最近的需求已经超过了供应量。

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
I can't keep my business busy without my special menu 'Crunch Crunch Sour' and 'Savory Yum Yum'...*Sigh*
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
如果没有我的特色菜单“嘎吱酸爽”和“美味滋味”，我的生意就没法红火起来……*唉*

scripts.text: 'Crunch Crunch Sour'?
scripts.translation: “嘎吱酸爽”？

scripts.text: 'Savory Yum Yum'?
scripts.translation: “美味香喷喷”？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
The basic ingredients of my Crunch Crunch Sour are the ants roaming inside the Ant Hell in the desert.
Rumor has it that the numbers of the ants have been greatly increased and they have become more violent, so that no one wants to get in the place.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
我那款“脆脆酸味饮”的基本原料，就是沙漠中蚂蚁地狱里游荡的蚂蚁。
传闻说蚂蚁的数量大幅增加，而且变得更加凶猛，所以谁都不愿意踏进那个地方。

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
*Sigh*...I am afraid that my business days are numbered now.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
*唉*……恐怕我的生意日子不多了。

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Savory Yum Yum's basic ingredients are the grasshoppers romping in a place over the west forest. Yeah, it is the best selling menu ever.
Rumor has it that they have become very violent and Bees have built their habitat in the place, so that no one wants to get in there.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
“美味香喷喷”的基本原料是普勒斯特以西某处蹦跳着的蝗虫。没错，那可是史上最畅销的菜单。
传闻说它们变得非常凶猛，而且蜜蜂也在那里建立了栖息地，所以谁都不愿意去那里。

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
*Sigh*...I am afraid that my business days are numbered now.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
*唉*……恐怕我的生意日子不多了。

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Take care of yourself~.
scripts.translation:
[调酒师]
请多保重~。

scripts.text:
[Shevild]
Hey, come on over and let's drink! I have lots of interesting stories to tell!
I know lots of things about Prontera. I have seen many fine views and I also have explored some monster lairs around this city.
scripts.translation:
[谢维尔德]
嘿，快过来一起喝点吧！我有好多有趣的故事要讲！
我对普隆德拉了解很多。我见过许多美景，也探索过这座城市周围的一些魔物巢穴。

scripts.text: How could you enter monster lairs?
scripts.translation: 你是怎么进入魔物巢穴的？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shevild]
I may appear to be a drunken man but I am more than meets the eye.
Well, I happened to enter the places for carrying weapons for hunters or for delivering stuffs and whatsoever.
You might think of me as a mere delivery guy,
scripts.translation:
[谢维尔德]
我看起来可能像个醉汉，但我可不只是表面看起来那样。
嗯，我刚好是趁着为猎人们运送武器或送货之类的机会进入那些地方的。
你可能会觉得我只是个普通的送货员，

scripts.text:
[Shevild]
But I am very proud of my job. You know how tough the world has become?
No matter how hard a work is, I am not afraid of doing that.
scripts.translation:
[谢维尔德]
但我对我的工作感到非常自豪。你知道这个世界变得多么艰难吗？
无论工作有多辛苦，我都不会退缩。

scripts.text:
[Shevild]
Anyways, that is how I have explored some strange places like monster lairs...
That is also a reason why I keep my job.
Ah, I just recall being inside the maze and the spooky forest!
scripts.translation:
[谢维尔德]
总之，这就是我如何探索魔物巢穴等奇特地方的方式...
这也是我能保住这份工作的原因。
啊，我刚才突然想起了在迷宫和阴森森林里的经历！

scripts.text: The Maze?
scripts.translation: 迷宫？

scripts.text: The Spooky Forest?
scripts.translation: 阴森森林？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shevild]
Yes. Few days ago, I have entered a mysterious maze following a group of hunters at the north of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[谢维尔德]
是的。几天前，我跟着一群猎人进入了普隆德拉北边的一个神秘迷宫。

scripts.text:
[Shevild]
They said that they could get lots and lots of rare items from the maze even if the maze was filled with awfully strong monsters.
So we went there but as soon as we entered, we were just stuck inside the maze, you know.
scripts.translation:
[谢维尔德]
他们说，即使迷宫里充满了极其强大的魔物，也能从迷宫里获得大量的稀有物品。
所以我们去了那里，但我们一进去，就发现自己被困在迷宫里了。

scripts.text:
[Shevild]
We were just circling around and then we decided to leave the place. That was one hell of the maze.
But I made up my mind that I would successfully explore the maze one day.
scripts.translation:
[谢维尔德]
我们一直在原地打转，最后决定离开那里。那真是个可怕的迷宫。
但我已经下定决心，总有一天我会成功探索那个迷宫的。

scripts.text: How can I get there?
scripts.translation: 我要怎么去那里？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shevild]
Err? Haven't you still toured the outside of Prontera?
The maze can be found inside a forest at the north of Prontera. Go check the north west side of the forest.
scripts.translation:
[谢维尔德]
诶？你还没去过普隆德拉郊外吗？
那个迷宫就在普隆德拉北边的森林里。去森林的西北侧看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Shevild]
Yeap, be careful when you adventure alone~
scripts.translation:
[谢维尔德]
没错，独自冒险时要小心点~

scripts.text:
[Shevild]
When you go outside of Prontera heading to north east, you will arrive at the peaceful ruins. I have been there a while ago, to deliver something to a priest.
I had to pass a forest on the way to the ruins, and the forest was filled with monkeys and raccoons.
scripts.translation:
[谢维尔德]
当你离开普隆德拉向东北方向走时，会到达一片宁静的遗迹。不久前我曾去过那里，给一位牧师送东西。
在前往遗迹的路上我必须经过一片森林，那片森林里到处都是猴子和浣熊。

scripts.text:
[Shevild]
Be forewarned that the forest is not a place to go on a picnic. If you drop something on the ground, the monkeys come out from nowhere and take away all of your possessions.
scripts.translation:
[谢维尔德]
先提醒你一下，那片森林可不是郊游的好地方。如果你把东西掉在地上，猴子会不知从哪里钻出来，把你所有的财物都抢走。

scripts.text: How can I get there?
scripts.translation: 我要怎么去那里？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shevild]
There is no road directly leads to the ruins. But if you go north and keep heading to east, you will get there.
Oh, be careful on your way to the ruins because there are some weird plant things that assault passersby for no reason.
scripts.translation:
[谢维尔德]
没有直接通往遗迹的路。但如果你向北走并一直向东前进，就能到达那里。
噢，去遗迹的路上要小心，因为那里有一些奇怪的植物会无缘无故地袭击路人。

scripts.text:
[Shevild]
Yeap, be careful when you adventure alone~
scripts.translation:
[谢维尔德]
没错，独自冒险时要小心点~

scripts.text:
[Shevild]
Yeap, be careful when you adventure alone~
scripts.translation:
[谢维尔德]
没错，独自冒险时要小心点~

scripts.text:
[Shevild]
Come back any time~
scripts.translation:
[谢维尔德]
随时欢迎回来~

scripts.text:
[TenSue]
What...?
Sick and tired of killing monsters on fields and in dungeons already? Come on...
scripts.translation:
[天穗]
什么...?
已经厌倦了在野外和地下城里杀怪吗？别这样嘛...

scripts.text:
[TenSue]
Hahaha, it seems you're pretty confident of your strength, huh? Hmm... Why don't you go join a guild? I mean, all the tough guys are going it.
scripts.translation:
[天穗]
哈哈哈，看来你对自己的实力相当自信嘛，嗯...？要不要考虑加入一个公会？我是说，那些厉害的角色都在这么做。

scripts.text:
[TenSue]
Personally though, I don't know any guilds, so you'll have to ask around. Make some contacts, connections, you know, networking.
scripts.translation:
[天穗]
不过就我个人而言，我不认识任何公会，所以你得四处打听一下。多交点朋友，建立一些人脉，你懂的，社交嘛。

scripts.text:
[TenSue]
I don't even know if you don't like taking orders, but if that's the case, why don't you make your own guild?
scripts.translation:
[天穗]
我甚至不知道你是不是不喜欢听从指挥，但如果是那样的话，为什么不自己创建一个公会呢？

scripts.text:
[TenSue]
One time I walked all the way to Al de Baran, instead of taking a warp. It was pretty dangerous with all those monsters!
scripts.translation:
[天穗]
有一次我没有使用传送，而是全程步行到了艾德加兰。路上到处都是怪物，真的挺危险的！

scripts.text:
[TenSue]
I almost died! Some of those monsters just kept following me and trying to kill me, even though I did nothing to them! It was pretty crazy.
scripts.translation:
[天穗]
我差点就没命了！有些怪物明明我什么都没做，却一直跟着我试图杀掉我！简直太疯狂了。

scripts.text:
[TenSue]
Well, still, I feel that taking the scenic route was worth it. There were some pretty magnificent sights on the way.
scripts.translation:
[天穗]
不过，我觉得走这条风景优美的路线还是值得的。一路上有很多非常壮丽的景色。

scripts.text:
[TenSue]
Even the city of Al de Baran is a splendid vision to the eyes, with its elegant architecture and romantic canal.
scripts.translation:
[天穗]
就连艾德加兰这座城市也美不胜收，有着优雅的建筑和浪漫的运河。

scripts.text:
[TenSue]
The headquarters of Kafra Corporation is also located in Al de Baran. You should really stop by and check it out for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[天穗]
卡普拉公司的总部也位于艾德加兰。你真的应该亲自去看看。

scripts.text:
[TenSue]
The kingdom of
Rune-Midgarts is ruled
by kind and benevolent
King Tristram III.
scripts.translation:
[天穗]
卢恩·米德加兹王国
由仁慈且宽厚的
特里斯坦三世国王
统治着。

scripts.text:
[TenSue]
We really owe the prosperity of Rune-Midgarts to him. He was able to convince the people to welcome outsiders into Prontera, as well as establish trade to foreign lands, like Amatsu and Kunlun.
scripts.translation:
[天穗]
卢恩·米德加兹的繁荣真的要归功于他。他成功说服了民众欢迎外来者进入普隆德拉，并建立了与樱花城和昆仑等异国他乡的贸易。

scripts.text:
[TenSue]
But sometimes...
It can be hard to believe he's such a brilliant and capable leader.
scripts.translation:
[天穗]
但有时候...
很难相信他竟然是一位如此卓越且能干的领导者。

scripts.text:
[TenSue]
After all, the only time I see him is when he's conducting weddings. Even if a wedding isn't going on, he's still kind of loitering around the Prontera church!
scripts.translation:
[天穗]
毕竟，我见到他的唯一机会就是他在主持婚礼的时候。即使没有婚礼，他也总是在普隆德拉教堂附近闲逛！

scripts.text:
[TenSue]
But...
I guess you can get away with a lot of things when you happen to be lord and ruler of an entire nation.
scripts.translation:
[天穗]
不过...
我想，如果你恰好是一个国家的君主和统治者，很多事情都是可以被原谅的。

scripts.text:
[Marvin]
Whether it's schmoozing with a member of the opposite sex, or battling monsters, I gotta say, it's all about ^333399skills^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马文]
无论是和异性搭讪，还是与怪物战斗，我不得不说，关键都在于^333399技巧^000000。

scripts.text:
[Marvin]
I can't help you much when it comes to the subject of talking to attractive women such as myself, but I can tell you a little more about skills that help in battle.
scripts.translation:
[马文]
关于如何与像我这样迷人的女性交谈，我帮不上什么忙，但我可以多告诉你一些关于战斗技巧的事情。

scripts.text:
[Marvin]
I don't really have any advice for skills when it comes to talking to a cute guy, but I can let you in on what I know about skills that help in battle.
scripts.translation:
[马文]
关于如何与可爱的男生搭讪，我真的没什么建议，但我可以告诉你一些我所知道的战斗技巧。

scripts.text:
[Marvin]
For most skills, the maximum level is level 10. It's easy to stress yourself out, since it takes so many points to completely master a skill. What skills should you choose?!
scripts.translation:
[马文]
对于大多数技能来说，最高等级是10级。想要完全掌握一项技能需要花费大量的点数，这很容易让人感到压力。你应该选择哪些技能呢？！

scripts.text:
[Marvin]
After all, if you spend too many skill points on one skill, you might not be able to learn another. That's right, there's a limit to the number of total skill points you can earn.
scripts.translation:
[马文]
毕竟，如果你把太多的技能点都投入到某一个技能上，可能就无法学习其他技能了。没错，你能获得的技能点总数是有上限的。

scripts.text:
[Marvin]
But you know what? Not every skill is mastered at level 10. You can master some skills at only level 5. And even better, some skills are already mastered at level 1 or 2.
scripts.translation:
[马文]
但你知道吗？并不是每个技能都要练到10级才算精通。有些技能只要练到5级就能精通。更棒的是，有些技能在1级或2级时就已经精通了。

scripts.text:
[Marvin]
So relax and plan ahead, so you can master all the skills that you really want to master the most. Also, don't just put skill points into anything. Remember to use your skill points wisely.
scripts.translation:
[马文]
所以放轻松，提前做好规划，这样你就能掌握所有你最想学的技能。另外，不要随随便便就把技能点加在任何技能上。记得要明智地使用你的技能点。

scripts.text:
[Tailor Ginedin Rephere]
11...
12...
Mmm, good. I think I'll be able to finish before tonight's party.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝 吉内丁·雷费尔]
11...
12...
嗯，很好。我想在今晚的聚会开始前应该能完成。

scripts.text:
[Tailor Ginedin Rephere]
Oh! I didn't realize I had a guest. How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[裁缝 吉内丁·雷费尔]
噢！我都没发现有客人来访。请问有什么可以帮您的？

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Dye Clothing
scripts.translation: 染色衣物

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Tailor Ginedin Rephere]
Life may have gotten a little better, but receiving all these orders? *Whew!* Young ladies these days must be very well off, so my services may no longer be a luxury.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝 吉内丁·雷费尔]
生活也许变得好了一些，但收到这么多订单？*呼！* 现在的年轻小姐们一定过得很富裕，所以我的服务可能不再是奢侈品了。

scripts.text:
[Tailor Ginedin Rephere]
Well, people like them probably further the pursuit of beauty and fashion. But, of course, that's only my opinion.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝 吉内丁·雷费尔]
嗯，像她们那样的人大概是在追求美和时尚吧。不过，当然，这只是我的个人观点。

scripts.text:
[Tailor Ginedin Rephere]
I believe for us humans, clothes are one of the few ways to show our personality, style, and beauty.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝 吉内丁·雷费尔]
我相信对于我们人类来说，衣服是展示个性、风格和美感的少数方式之一。

scripts.text:
[Tailor Ginedin Rephere]
Considering this, I personally think my job is very helpful and rather fancy. This in itself makes it all worthwhile. Coarse fabric and rough leather burst with energy and life when colored...
scripts.translation:
[裁缝 吉内丁·雷费尔]
考虑到这一点，我个人认为我的工作非常有意义，而且相当华丽。这本身就让一切变得值得。粗糙的面料和粗砺的皮革在染色后会焕发出活力与生命力……

scripts.text:
[Tailor Ginedin Rephere]
It is a very hard and tedious process, but the happiness and delight you feel when your clothes are done makes up for all the hard work.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝 吉内丁·雷费尔]
这是一个非常艰辛且乏味的过程，但当衣服完工时，你所感受到的幸福与喜悦会弥补所有的辛劳。

scripts.text:
[Tailor Ginedin Rephere]
Ah...!
You came to dye
your clothes as well.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝 吉内丁·雷费尔]
啊...!
你也是来
染色衣服的吗。

scripts.text:
[Tailor Ginedin Rephere]
But... I'm so sorry.
I don't have enough time to dye your clothes right now. I have so many orders that are still waiting to be done.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝 吉内丁·雷费尔]
但是... 非常抱歉。
我现在没有足够的时间为您染色。我还有好多订单等着处理。

scripts.text:
[Tailor Ginedin Rephere]
I'm sorry for the inconvenience, but could you come back again next time?
scripts.translation:
[裁缝 吉内丁·雷费尔]
很抱歉给您带来不便，能不能请您下次再来？

scripts.text:
[Tailor Ginedin Rephere]
Feel free to take your time and relax here. I apologize that I have nothing to serve you, though.
scripts.translation:
[裁缝 吉内丁·雷费尔]
请随意在这里休息放松。不过很抱歉，我没有什么可以招待您的。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
Hello there~
Are you interested in learning more about helping and supporting other people?
scripts.translation:
[加尔内特]
你好呀~
你有没有兴趣了解更多关于如何帮助和支持他人的知识？

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
The Acolytes and Priests trained in this church can heal people, cure them of certain conditions, and even awaken the battle potential of other adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内特]
在这座教堂接受训练的服事和牧师可以治愈人们，解除某些异常状态，甚至能激发其他冒险者的战斗潜力。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
Go and ahead and ask if you have any questions about skills for Acolytes and Priests.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内特]
如果你对服事和牧师的技能有任何疑问，尽管去问问吧。

scripts.text: About Heal
scripts.translation: 关于治疗

scripts.text: About Cure
scripts.translation: 关于净化

scripts.text: About Increase AGI
scripts.translation: 关于 Agi Up

scripts.text: About Angelus
scripts.translation: 关于圣光术

scripts.text: About Blessing
scripts.translation: 关于祝福术

scripts.text: About Warp Portal
scripts.translation: 关于传送门

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
You can recover your own HP with the ^6666CCHeal^000000 skill. Healing is one of the most important ways you can help your friends in battle.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内特]
你可以使用 ^6666CC治疗^000000 技能来恢复自己的 HP。治疗是你在战斗中帮助队友最重要的方式之一。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
Even though our powers are usually used to heal others, you can actually use the ^6666CCHeal^000000 skill to hurt Undead monsters.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内特]
虽然我们的力量通常是用来治疗他人的，但实际上你也可以使用 ^6666CC治疗^000000 技能来伤害不死系怪物。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
Just remember to hold down the ^6666CCShift^000000 key when you use Cure or Heal on Undead monsters. Just be sure to hurt the monsters though, and don't use it to help monsters.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内特]
只需记住，在对不死系怪物使用净化或治疗时，按住 ^6666CCShift^000000 键即可。但请务必确保是用来伤害怪物，而不是用来帮助它们。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
Later, if you've learned ^6666CCHeal^000000 as an Acolyte, you can learn ^6666CCSanctuary^000000 if you become a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内特]
稍后，如果你作为服事学会了 ^6666CC治疗^000000，当你成为牧师后，就可以学习 ^6666CC圣域^000000 了。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
Priests use ^6666CCSantuary^000000 to create an area which will restore the HP of you and your friends if you rest within the Sanctuary's area.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内特]
牧师使用 ^6666CC圣域^000000 来创造一个区域，如果你在圣域范围内休息，该区域会恢复你和队友的 HP。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
Once you reach ^6666CCLevel 2 Heal^000000 as an Acolyte, you can learn ^6666CCCure^000000, which can be used to treat abnormal statuses.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内特]
一旦你作为服事达到了 ^6666CC治疗等级 2^000000，你就可以学习 ^6666CC净化^000000，它可以用来治疗异常状态。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
This skill can be such a life saver, since almost every abnormal status can be cured with the Cure skill. Just remember that you need ^6666CCLevel 2 Heal^000000 before you can learn Cure.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内et]
这项技能可以成为救命稻草，因为几乎所有的异常状态都可以通过净化技能来解除。只需记住，在学习净化之前，你需要先达到 ^6666CC治疗等级 2^000000。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
Now, the ^6666CCIncrease AGI^000000 skill can be used on you or your friends. For a while your AGI stat is increased, making you attack faster and dodge monster attacks more easily.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内特]
现在，^6666CC敏捷提升^000000 技能可以对你或你的队友使用。在一段时间内，你的 AGI 属性会提升，使你的攻击速度更快，并更容易躲避怪物的攻击。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
If you're an Acolyte that wants to learn ^6666CCIncrease AGI^000000, you need to learn ^6666CCLevel 3 Heal^000000 first.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内特]
如果你是想要学习 ^6666CC敏捷提升^000000 的服事，你需要先学习 ^6666CC治疗等级 3^000000。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
You can use ^6666CCAngelus^000000 to increase your Defense, as well as the Defense of other party members. Remember though, you can only use ^6666CCAngelus^000000 on other people if they are in your party.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内特]
你可以使用 ^6666CC圣光术^000000 来提升你的防御力以及其他队友的防御力。但请记住，只有当其他人在你的队伍中时，你才能对他们使用 ^6666CC圣光术^000000。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
Before you can learn Angelus, you will need to have ^6666CCLevel 3 Divine Protection^000000.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内特]
在学习圣光术之前，你需要拥有 ^6666CC守护术等级 3^000000。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
Also, if you keep learning Angelus, you'll eventually be able to learn ^6666CCKyrie Eleison^000000. That skill helps you evade initial attacks automatically.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内et]
此外，如果你继续学习圣光术，最终你将能够学习 ^6666CC神圣之光^000000。该技能可以帮助你自动规避初次攻击。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
^6666CCBlessing^000000 temporarily increases STR, DEX and INT. This skill will give you and your friends a great advantage in battle!
scripts.translation:
[加尔内et]
^6666CC祝福术^000000 会暂时提升 STR、DEX 和 INT。这项技能将在战斗中为你和你的队友带来巨大的优势！

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
Before you can learn Blessing, you must first learn ^6666CCLevel 5 Divine Protection^000000.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内et]
在学习祝福术之前，你必须先学习 ^6666CC守护术等级 5^000000。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
^6666CCWarp Portal^000000 is a pretty complex skill, and you need to know some other skills before you can learn it.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内et]
^6666CC传送门^000000 是一项相当复杂的技能，在学习它之前，你需要先掌握其他一些技能。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
First, you need to learn ^6666CCRuwach^000000 which lets you see invisible monsters. After Ruwach, you will need to learn the ^6666CCTeleport^000000 skill.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内et]
首先，你需要学习 ^6666CC侦察^000000 来发现隐身怪物。在学会侦察之后，你还需要学习 ^6666CC传送^000000 技能。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
Once you learn ^6666CCWarp Portal^000000, the level of the Warp Portal skill will determine how many warp destinations, or Warp Points, you can memorize.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内特]
一旦你学会了 ^6666CC传送门^000000，传送门技能的等级将决定你可以记忆多少个传送目的地，也就是传送点。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
If you master the Warp Portal skill, you can have a maximum of 4 different Warp Points. But at least one Warp Point is designated as the Save Point that you've made with a Kafra Employee.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内特]
如果你精通传送门技能，你最多可以拥有4个不同的传送点。但其中至少有一个传送点会被指定为你向卡普拉服务员设置的存档点。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
Well, it's a bit of hassle, but if you want to make a certain place one of your Warp Points, you need to be physically there first. Then, type in ^6666CC/memo^000000 into the command prompt.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内特]
嗯，虽然有点麻烦，但如果你想把某个地方设为你的传送点之一，你必须先亲自到达那里。然后，在指令栏输入 ^6666CC/memo^000000。

scripts.text:
[Garnet]
Just so you know, you can't save a Warp Point inside of a dungeon. Oh, and don't forget, each time you make a Warp Portal, you must use 1 ^6666CCBlue Gemstone^000000 as a Catalyst.
scripts.translation:
[加尔内特]
提醒一下，你不能在地下城内保存传送点。噢，还有别忘了，每次使用传送门时，你都必须使用1个 ^6666CC蓝色宝石原石^000000 作为媒介。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright, I've
heard enough.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我
听够了。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
We Priests and Acolytes are not only limited to easing the suffering of our fellow man...
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
我们牧师和服事不仅限于减轻同胞的痛苦……

scripts.text:
[Henson]
We also mete swift and merciless punishment to the forces of evil. Well, purifying any poor souls that may have been turned into the Undead is also another duty.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
我们也会对邪恶势力施以迅速而无情的惩罚。此外，净化那些可能已变成不死生物的可怜灵魂也是我们的职责之一。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
Did you have any questions about Acolyte and Priest skills?
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
关于服事和牧师的技能，你有什么疑问吗？

scripts.text: About Divine Protection
scripts.translation: 关于神圣保护

scripts.text: About Demon Bane
scripts.translation: 关于恶魔之咒

scripts.text: About Decrease AGI
scripts.translation: 关于降低敏捷

scripts.text: About Signum Crusis
scripts.translation: 关于十字军圣印

scripts.text: About Pneuma
scripts.translation: 关于精神防御

scripts.text: About Ruwach
scripts.translation: 关于通晓

scripts.text: About Teleport
scripts.translation: 关于传送

scripts.text: End conversation.
scripts.translation: 结束对话。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
If you want to permanently improve your Defense against the Undead, learn ^6666CCDivine Protection^000000.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
如果你想永久提升对不死生物的防御力，请学习 ^6666CC神圣保护^000000。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
Learning Divine Protection to certain levels will also allow you to learn other skills, like ^6666CCAngelus^000000 and ^6666CCBlessing^000000, which Garnet can explain.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
将神圣保护学习到一定等级后，你还可以学习其他技能，比如 ^6666CC天使之祝福^000000 和 ^6666CC祝福^000000，加尔内特可以为你解释。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
When you learn ^6666CCLevel 3 Divine Protection^000000, you will then be able to learn the ^6666CCDemon Bane^000000 skill.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
当你学会 ^6666CC3级神圣保护^000000 时，你就可以学习 ^6666CC恶魔之咒^000000 技能了。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
With ^6666CCDemon Bane^000000, the damage of your attacks against the Undead will be increased. Permanently.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
有了 ^6666CC恶魔之咒^000000，你对不死生物的攻击伤害将会提升。是永久性的提升。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
^6666CCDemon Bane^000000 increases the damage you will inflict upon the Undead. Permanently.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
^6666CC恶魔之咒^000000 会永久增加你对不死生物造成的伤害。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
First, you'll need to learn ^6666CCLevel 3 Divine Protection^000000 to be able to learn Demon Bane, so keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
首先，你需要先学会 ^6666CC3级神圣保护^000000 才能学习恶魔克星，请记住这一点。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
When you learn ^6666CCLevel 3 Demon Bane^000000, you will be able to learn ^6666CCSignum Crusis^000000, which lowers the Defense of Undead monsters, as well as monsters with the Dark property.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
当你学会 ^6666CC3级恶魔克星^000000 时，你就能学习 ^6666CC十字圣痕^000000 了，该技能可以降低不死属性以及暗属性怪物的防御力。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
Using ^6666CCDecrease AGI^000000 on monsters will slow their movement, attack speed, and the rate at which they can evade your own attacks. That way, you can maim them properly.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
对怪物使用 ^6666CC减速^000000 可以降低它们的移动速度、攻击速度以及躲避你攻击的概率。这样你就能有效地制服它们。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
Remember, you must first learn ^6666CCLevel 2 Increase AGI^000000 if you want to be able to learn the Decrease AGI skill.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
请记住，如果你想学习减速技能，必须先学会 ^6666CC2级加速^000000。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
The ^6666CCSignum Crusis^000000 skill lowers the Defense of monsters with the Undead or Dark properties. It has a wide range and can be quite powerful.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
^6666CC十字圣痕^000000 技能可以降低具有不死或暗属性怪物的防御力。它的范围很广，威力非常强大。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
However, it's a very difficult skill to use, and it has a relatively low success rate. But, do not despair if this skill is not successful all the time.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
然而，这是一个非常难以使用的技能，成功率也相对较低。但如果这个技能没有一直成功，也不要灰心。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
When it does work, it will give you a great battle advantage. Remember, you will ^6666CCLevel 3 Demon Bane^000000 to acquire this skill.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
一旦成功，它会为你带来巨大的战斗优势。请记住，你需要通过 ^6666CC3级恶魔克星^000000 来获取此技能。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
The ^6666CCPneuma^000000 allows you to generate a barrier that will block all long-range attacks in a certain range, creating a zone that will protect you from monsters that attack from a distance.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
^6666CC守护术^000000 可以让你产生一个屏障，阻挡一定范围内的所有远程攻击，创造出一个保护你免受远程怪物攻击的区域。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
In order to become ready to learn Pneuma, you must first completely master the ^6666CCWarp Portal^000000 skill.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
为了准备学习守护术，你必须先完全掌握 ^6666CC传送门^000000 技能。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
Nothing can escape the eyes of the Holy! ^6666CCRuwach^000000 allows you to see monsters, as well as other adventurers, that are hidden or invisible.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
没有什么能逃过神圣之眼的眼睛！^6666CC圣光术^000000 可以让你看见处于隐藏或隐身状态的怪物以及其他冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
Once you learn Ruwach, you will be able to learn the ^6666CCTeleport^000000 skill.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
一旦你学会了圣光术，你就能学习 ^6666CC传送^000000 技能了。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
First, you must learn the ^6666CCRuwach^000000 skill in order to learn how to Teleport.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
首先，你必须学会 ^6666CC圣光术^000000 才能学习如何传送。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
The ^6666CCTeleport^000000 skill teleports you to a random location in the field or city which you are currently in. Teleport will prove useful for quick escapes, but where you may end up is... unpredictable.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
^6666CC传送^000000 技能会将你传送到你当前所在的地图或城市中的随机位置。传送在快速逃生时非常有用，但你最终会落到哪里……是无法预料的。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
Once the Teleport skill is mastered, you can Teleport to the latest Save Point that you have made with a Kafra Employee. I do not know why it is that way, but the Lord works in mysterious ways.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
一旦掌握了传送技能，你就可以传送到最近一次在卡普拉服务员处设置的存档点。我不知道为什么会这样，但主的旨意是不可测的。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
When Teleport is mastered, you can also learn the ^6666CCWarp Portal^000000 skill. Ask Garnet if you wish to know more about Warp Portal.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
当传送技能掌握后，你还可以学习 ^6666CC传送门^000000 技能。如果你想了解更多关于传送门的信息，可以去问问加尔内特。

scripts.text:
[Henson]
If you wish to understand more about an Acolyte or Priest skill, you are welcome to visit me at any time.
scripts.translation:
[亨森]
如果你想了解更多关于服事或牧师的技能，欢迎随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
H-hey!
What are
you doing here?!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
喂——！
你在这里
做什么？！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Don't you know there's a Demon living in this forest?! I can't guarantee your safety
if you go in!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
你不知道这片森林里住着恶魔吗？！如果你进去的话，我可无法保证你的安全！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
*Sigh...* The last guy that entered this place haven't come back at all. He didn't listen to me and went in to gather Herbs or something dumb like that...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
*唉……* 上一个进入这里的人就再也没回来过。他不听我的劝告，跑进去采什么草药之类的蠢事……

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Whaaaat a stupid guy. Why would anyone want to throw his life away just to collect some silly Herbs?
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
真是个笨蛋。为什么要为了收集一些没用的草药而丢掉性命呢？
